definitions: A group of photosynthetic bacteria, also known as cyanobacteria, that live in water and can produce toxins.
Microscopic organisms found in fresh and saltwater, often forming blooms that can be harmful to humans and animals.
examples: The lake was contaminated with blue-green algae.
Scientists are studying the effects of blue-green algae on aquatic ecosystems.
A bloom of blue-green algae covered the surface of the pond.
